cubejs 1.3.2 (npm "cubejs", https://github.com/ldez/cubejs) - Herbert Kociemba's two-phase algorithm for the 3x3x3 cube.
cube.js and solve.js are the unmodified plain-JS builds from the npm package (lib/).  worker.js is our own small wrapper.
